Monarch

Monarch introduces the first gamified iteration of standard ERC404 allowing holders to evolve their NFTs via competition on-chain. In such use-case, trait rarity does not depict value, but on-chain activity does. 8,888 unique Dragons will be minted and burned in this process. Be ready.

CA: 0x6c061d18d2b5bbfbe8a8d1eeb9ee27efd544cc5d

hatch.execute()

importbreed

Gameplay

1.

After the “HATCHING”, each user will be given a Base Dragon (D1), these Dragons are an identical type, however have different color traits

2.

Excluding D1, there are 4 different dragon types (D2-D5)

3.

Goal of the game is to level up to the rarest Dragon type.

4.

Compete in the “DUNGEON” for a chance to level up & win the Jackpot.

5.

There is no pre-determined Dragon rarity. Rarity is created through game activity.

Phase II

DUNGEON

• 30 MIN PER ROUND

• ENTRY FEE = .02 ETH

J = jackpot amount in eth

N = # of participants in round

F = Entry fee in eth

J = N x F

JACKPOT AMOUNT (J) IS EQUAL TO THE NUMBER OF PARTICIPANTS (N) MULTIPLIED BY THE ENTRY FEE PER PARTICIPANT (F)

Phase III

LEGACY

  • • COMMENCES ONCE ALL DRAGON TYPES HAVE BEEN HATCHED
  • • DRAGON HOLDERS CAN STAKE TO EARN $LEGACY
  • • $LEGACY IS TO BE CLAIMED FOR USE OF PURCHASE OF ADD-ONS FOR YOUR DRAGON
  • • THESE ADD-ONS ARE LIMITED AND FIRST COME FIRST SERVE
